project: 化龙镇中心幼儿园电子资源平台 / Hualong Kindergarten Electronic Resource Platform
note: Canonical bilingual glossary. Single source of truth for terminology. The wording judge (harness/judges/wording_judge.py) and glossary checker (harness/glossary-check.mjs) read this file. When a term is resolved or changed, edit it HERE and nowhere else.

rules.casing_en: Use the canonical English exactly as written (sentence case unless a proper noun).
rules.punctuation_zh: Chinese prose uses full-width punctuation （，。！？：；“”）. Half-width is flagged.
rules.first_use: On first use in a document, write the bilingual pair: 简中 (English). Thereafter either is acceptable.
rules.forbidden_is_error: Any term listed under variants_forbidden is a P1 finding — replace with the canonical term.

terms.definition_zh: 面向化龙镇中心幼儿园的微信小程序 + PC 后台，统一管理园所资源、教研、党建、家园共育等内容。
terms.definition_en: The WeChat Mini Program plus PC backend serving Hualong Kindergarten; the single system that manages resources, teaching-research, party-building, and home-school co-education.

terms.definition_zh: 园所管理者使用的端口，负责审核、发布共建任务、内容与用户管理。
terms.definition_en: The interface used by kindergarten managers: audits, publishing co-construction tasks, content and user management.

terms.definition_zh: 教师使用的端口，负责上传资源/案例、完成任务、发布在园时光与评价。
terms.definition_en: The interface used by teachers: uploading resources/cases, completing tasks, publishing garden moments and evaluations.

terms.definition_zh: 家长使用的端口，只保留家园社共育相关内容；不展示党建、综合协调、教研培训等教师端模块。
terms.definition_en: The interface used by parents; surfaces only home-school-community co-education content. It never shows party-building, administrative-coordination, or teaching-research modules.

terms.definition_zh: 桌面端管理后台，承担文件类资料上传与批量管理；手机端用于高频轻量操作。
terms.definition_en: The desktop management backend; handles file-heavy uploads and bulk management, while the mobile clients handle high-frequency lightweight actions.

terms.definition_zh: 各端入口页，聚合待办事项、资源中心通知、常用入口、推荐课程案例；按端口显示不同内容。
terms.definition_en: The per-role landing page aggregating to-do items, resource-center notices, quick entries, and recommended course cases; content varies by role.

terms.definition_zh: 党建学习、党建活动、品牌建设三类资料的呈现；以查看为主，上传建议放 PC 后台。
terms.definition_en: Presentation of party-building study materials, activities, and brand-building; primarily view-oriented, with uploads recommended via the PC backend.

terms.definition_zh: 行政统筹、后勤保障、人事管理三类文件资料；手机端查看为主，PC 端上传为主。
terms.definition_en: Administrative planning, logistics support, and HR management documents; mobile is view-first, PC is upload-first.

terms.definition_zh: 课程建设、课程库+资源库、教研研修三大块；1.0 重点为课程资源、教研资料、评价五维图。
terms.definition_en: Curriculum development, the curriculum+resource libraries, and teaching-research study; v1.0 focuses on course resources, teaching-research materials, and the five-dimension evaluation.

terms.definition_zh: 在园时光、亲子任务（含社区教育）、成长档案、成长册四大块。注意：模块名统一为“家园社共育”（含“社”），流程图标题“家园共育”为旧称，见 ADR-0002。
terms.definition_en: Garden moments, parent-child tasks (including community education), growth records, and growth books. NOTE: the canonical module name includes 社 (community); the flowchart title 家园共育 is the legacy name — see ADR-0002.

terms.definition_zh: 首页按端口显示的待办：管理端（审核、共建任务）、教师端（上传、待完成任务）、家长端（通知、亲子任务）。
terms.definition_en: Role-specific pending items on Home: admin (audits, co-construction tasks), teacher (uploads, pending tasks), parent (notices, parent-child tasks).

terms.definition_zh: 按“衣/食/住/行/艺”分类的资源；资源详情含简介、解读、获取、转化建议、关联课程案例。
terms.definition_en: Resources classified by 衣/食/住/行/艺 (clothing/food/housing/travel/arts); a resource detail holds intro, interpretation, access, conversion suggestions, and linked course cases.

terms.definition_zh: 又称课程库；按年级/五大领域/活动形式/资源标签筛选；案例详情含简介、详案、教师自评、他评、活动反思、关联资源。
terms.definition_en: Also called the curriculum library; filtered by grade / five domains / activity form / resource tag; a case detail holds intro, full plan, teacher self-evaluation, peer evaluation, activity reflection, and linked resources.

terms.definition_zh: 教师选择班级/幼儿后发布照片/视频/文字，对应家长查看；建议一周两次频率。
terms.definition_en: Teachers select a class/child then publish photos/videos/text for the matching parents to view; a roughly twice-weekly cadence is suggested.

terms.definition_zh: 教师发布任务（普通亲子 / 社区教育），家长上传图片/文字/视频反馈，教师查看完成进度。
terms.definition_en: Teachers publish a task (ordinary parent-child or community education); parents upload image/text/video feedback; teachers track completion.

terms.definition_zh: 亲子任务的一种类型，面向社区教育场景。
terms.definition_en: A type of parent-child task aimed at community-education scenarios.

terms.definition_zh: 含月度评价与学期评价；学期评价填写五大领域量表并生成五维雷达图与综合评估报告。
terms.definition_en: Holds monthly and term evaluations; the term evaluation fills the five-domain scale and generates the five-dimension radar chart and an assessment report.

terms.definition_zh: 选择模板、勾选纳入内容（在园时光/亲子任务/评价/园所介绍等），预览后确认发布或导出，家长端查看。
terms.definition_en: Pick a template, check the content to include (garden moments / tasks / evaluations / kindergarten intro, etc.), preview, then publish or export for parents to view.

terms.definition_zh: 选择月份/幼儿后填写并发布给家长。
terms.definition_en: Select a month/child, fill in, and publish to parents.

terms.definition_zh: 填写五大领域量表→生成五维雷达图→生成综合评估报告→导出/发布。
terms.definition_en: Fill the five-domain scale → generate the radar chart → generate the assessment report → export/publish.

terms.definition_zh: 基于五大领域量表生成的雷达图，用于学期综合评价可视化。
terms.definition_en: A radar chart generated from the five-domain scale, visualizing the term assessment.

terms.definition_zh: 国家《3-6岁儿童学习与发展指南》五大领域：健康、语言、社会、科学、艺术。
terms.definition_en: The five learning domains from China's national early-learning guidelines: health, language, society, science, and arts.

terms.definition_zh: 明确不纳入小程序，由园方通过企业微信单独收集（见流程图 04）。
terms.definition_en: Explicitly OUT of the Mini Program scope; collected separately by the kindergarten via WeCom (see flowchart 04).

terms.definition_zh: 管理端发布、选择参与教师、设截止时间与说明，看任务进度看板。
terms.definition_en: Published by admin; select participating teachers, set deadline and description, and watch the task-progress board.

terms.definition_zh: 管理端对资源/案例提交的审核：通过→进入资源库/案例库；驳回→填写原因并退回教师修改。
terms.definition_en: Admin review of submitted resources/cases: approve → enters the library; reject → enter a reason and return to the teacher for revision.

terms.definition_zh: 审核通过，内容进入资源库/案例库展示。
terms.definition_en: Approve in review; the content enters the library for display.

terms.definition_zh: 审核不通过，必须填写原因并退回教师修改。
terms.definition_en: Reject in review; a reason is required and the item returns to the teacher for revision.

terms.definition_zh: 教师上传内容的未提交状态。
terms.definition_en: The unsubmitted state of teacher-uploaded content.

terms.definition_zh: 资源中心通知与各端通知列表；通过订阅消息提醒。
terms.definition_en: Resource-center notices and per-role notice lists; reminders via subscribe messages.

terms.definition_zh: PC后台：名单导入、手动录入、搜索（幼儿园/教师/班级/家长）、权限分配（三端）。
terms.definition_en: PC backend: roster import, manual entry, search (kindergarten/teacher/class/parent), and role assignment across the three clients.

terms.definition_zh: 批量导入教师/幼儿/家长名单。
terms.definition_en: Bulk import of teacher/child/parent rosters.

terms.definition_zh: 为用户分配管理端/教师端/家长端权限。
terms.definition_en: Assigning admin/teacher/parent permissions to users.

terms.definition_zh: 后台记录详案下载的账号与时间。
terms.definition_en: The backend records the account and time of full-plan downloads.

terms.definition_zh: v1.x 能力：依据教师的兴趣画像，对资源库/案例库进行按人排序与“为你推荐”呈现；面向教师，默认开启且可随时关闭。区别于首页人工编排的“推荐课程案例”（编辑推荐，非算法）。
terms.definition_en: A v1.x capability: per-teacher ranking and a 为你推荐 surface over the resource/case libraries, driven by the teacher's interest profile; default-on with an always-available off switch. Distinct from the editorially curated 'recommended course cases' on Home (human-curated, not algorithmic).

terms.definition_zh: 由教师在知情同意下、以去除 child_id 的行为信号推导出的内容偏好标签；仅限偏好层级（如偏好的资源分类、媒体形式），绝不包含对幼儿的需求判断或推断。仅面向成人（教师）。注意：单独的“画像”一词保留指代角色画像。
terms.definition_en: Content-preference tags derived from a teacher's consented, child_id-free behavior signals; preference-level only (e.g., preferred resource categories, media form), never a need/diagnosis or any inference about a child. Adults (teachers) only. Note: bare 画像 stays reserved for personas/role profiles.

terms.definition_zh: 微信平台强制要求：所有 UGC（文本/图片/视频/音频/昵称头像）须经 security.msgSecCheck / security.mediaCheckAsync 校验。未实现即审核不通过。
terms.definition_en: Mandatory on the WeChat platform: every UGC item (text/image/video/audio/nickname/avatar) must pass security.msgSecCheck / security.mediaCheckAsync. Omitting it fails review.

terms.definition_zh: 2023-09-01 起强制：上线前完成工信部备案（含 12381 短信核验）。
terms.definition_en: Mandatory since 2023-09-01: complete MIIT filing before go-live (includes 12381 SMS verification).

terms.definition_zh: 主体认证，¥300/年；公办幼儿园按政府/事业单位主体认证。
terms.definition_en: Subject verification, ¥300/year; a public kindergarten verifies as a government/public-institution subject.

terms.definition_zh: 幼儿照片等敏感信息：须监护人明示同意、隐私政策弹窗、数据最小化、严格访问控制（PIPL + 未成年人网络保护条例）。
terms.definition_en: Sensitive data such as children's photos: requires explicit guardian consent, a privacy-policy popup, data minimization, and strict access control (PIPL + minors' online-protection regulation).

terms.definition_zh: 个人信息保护法第 24 条：以自动化方式进行用户分析与推荐等决策时，须提供不针对个人特征的选项或便捷的拒绝方式，并保障知情与解释权。个性化推荐据此提供关闭开关与说明。
terms.definition_en: PIPL Article 24: when profiling/recommendation is carried out by automated means, the platform must offer an opt-out (or a non-targeted option) plus transparency and a right to explanation. 个性化推荐 honors this via its off switch and notice.

terms.definition_zh: 依据《互联网信息服务算法推荐管理规定》对符合条件的算法推荐服务进行的备案。按用户的个性化推荐是否触发该备案，需法务确认；聚合、去标识的统计洞察不触发。
terms.definition_en: Filing required by the Provisions on the Management of Algorithmic Recommendations in Internet Information Services for qualifying algorithmic recommendation services. Whether per-user 个性化推荐 triggers it is a legal question to confirm; aggregate, de-identified insight does not.

terms.definition_zh: 替代已下线的模板消息，用于通知/任务提醒；一次性较现实，长期需类目资格。
terms.definition_en: Replaces the retired template messages; used for notice/task reminders. One-time is realistic; long-term needs category eligibility.

terms.definition_zh: 微信 CloudBase 一体化后端：云数据库/云函数/云存储，自动注入 openid，免域名备案与运维。
terms.definition_en: WeChat CloudBase integrated backend: cloud database/functions/storage, auto-injected openid, no domain filing or server ops.

terms.definition_zh: 用户在本小程序的唯一标识，由 wx.login → code2session 换取。
terms.definition_en: The user's unique id within this Mini Program, obtained via wx.login → code2session.
